g.text: Half of Sindh's urban earners make under Rs 264,000 a year; the top tenth make over Rs 696,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file (earnings) merged with household file (weights, province, area).
Sample: Sindh urban earners aged 15-64 with annual earnings > 0 (n = 2,644). 2 earners outside Rs 10,000-Rs 10,000,000 excluded.
Weighted by hhweight; bins 0.1 wide in log10 units; density per log10 unit.
